display.purpose: Hero headline only, one per page. Carries a hard ink text-shadow.

headline.purpose: Section titles. Always paired with the yellow scroll-in underline.

title.purpose: Location names, item sheet titles, card headings.

body.purpose: Document baseline at 14px/1.6. Prose capped at 65-75ch.

body-lede.purpose: Hero subtitle and shop intro. The 24px desktop size is the WCAG large-text threshold, not a style choice.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, field labels, pills, chips. Always uppercase mono, tracked 0.16-0.2em.

meta.purpose: Prices, hours, addresses, map annotation. Tabular numerals wherever figures change.

button.purpose: Every actionable label. Bowlby One uppercase at 0.05em.

shadows.name: nudge
shadows.purpose: Nav order button and bag button. Small, tight, always present.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Featured rows, selected chips, small cards.

shadows.name: standard
shadows.purpose: Default lifted surface. Location cards, phone primary buttons, menu cards.

shadows.name: anchor
shadows.purpose: Hero image and desktop buttons and cards at rest.

shadows.name: hover-extension
shadows.purpose: Paired with translate(-3px,-3px) on hover. The element lifts and the shadow grows to match.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The only blurred shadow allowed. Lifted sticky header, bag drawer, order dock. Nothing else in the system is allowed blur, and nothing emits light.

motion.name: ease-brand
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for reveals, underline wipes, thumbnail scale.

motion.name: ease-press
motion.purpose: The 0.08s tactile press on hover-lift and hover-grow elements.

motion.name: ease-stamp
motion.purpose: Overshoot for the chip stamp and bag bump. The only place overshoot is allowed.

motion.name: duration-press
motion.purpose: Button transform and shadow on press. Fast enough to feel mechanical.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals and the section underline wipe.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The order CTA. Yellow fill, ink border, and a hard offset shadow it falls into when pressed.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Bowlby One', Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 19px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; background: #f5b82e; color: #1a1612; border: 4px solid #1a1612; border-radius: 0; padding: 22px 34px; box-shadow: 7px 7px 0 #1a1612; transition: transform 0.14s, box-shadow 0.14s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 #1a1612; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1a1612; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #1a1612; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The non-committal action beside the CTA. Same geometry, cream fill, no color of its own.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Bowlby One', Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 19px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; background: #fff2c9; color: #1a1612; border: 4px solid #1a1612; border-radius: 0; padding: 22px 34px; box-shadow: 7px 7px 0 #1a1612; transition: transform 0.14s, box-shadow 0.14s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 #1a1612; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1a1612; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #1a1612; }

components.name: Nav Order Button
components.description: The miniature of the primary button, pinned to the right of the sticky header.
components.css: .ds-btn-order { display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'Bowlby One', Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; background: #f5b82e; color: #1a1612; border: 2px solid #1a1612; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 11px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #1a1612; transition: transform 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-order:hover { transform: translate(-2px, -2px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #1a1612; } .ds-btn-order:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1a1612; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-order:active { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #1a1612; }

components.name: Store Status Tag
components.description: Live open/closed state in the header: a two-cell punch card. The state in the display face on cream with the pulsing dot, the fact it implies reversed out on ink in the mono. Square, ruled and shadowed like every other object here.
components.css: .ds-stat { display: inline-flex; align-items: stretch; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; border: 2px solid #1a1612; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #1a1612; } .ds-stat-a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 10px 8px; background: #fff2c9; color: #1a1612; font-family: 'Bowlby One', Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-stat-b { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 8px; border-left: 2px solid #1a1612; background: #1a1612; color: #fff2c9; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-stat-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2f6b43; flex: none; animation: ds-stat-pulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-stat-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(0.8); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stat-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Topic Chip
components.description: Radio group as pills on the contact check. Selection lands like a rubber stamp, with rotation.
components.css: .ds-chip { position: relative; display: inline-flex; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-chip input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; margin: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 12px; border: 2px solid #e3d8bc; border-radius: 999px; color: #7a6f5e; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), border-color 0.18s, color 0.18s, background 0.18s; } .ds-chip input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid #1a1612; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chip input:checked + span { background: #d0281c; border-color: #d0281c; color: #fff2c9; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #1a1612; animation: ds-chip-stamp 0.34s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); } .ds-chip input:checked + span::before { content: '\2713'; font-size: 11px; } @keyframes ds-chip-stamp { 0% { transform: scale(1.16) rotate(-3.5deg); } 60% { transform: scale(0.97) rotate(1.2deg); } 100% { transform: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-chip input:checked + span { animation: none; } }

components.name: Location Card
components.description: A store. Square, heavy ink border, offset shadow. Unopened stores use the same border dashed and drop the shadow entirely.
components.html:
HOLLYWOOD

5539 W. SUNSET BLVD

Open til 2AM Friday and Saturday. Every topping free.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: #fffdf6; color: #1a1612; border: 4px solid #1a1612; border-radius: 0; padding: 22px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #1a1612; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.25s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translate(-3px, -3px); box-shadow: 11px 11px 0 #e63027; border-color: #e63027; } .ds-card h3 { font-family: 'Bowlby One', Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #7a6f5e; margin: 0 0 10px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Ruled Input
components.description: No box. A mono label over a ruled line, with a red underline that wipes in from the left on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 5px; max-width: 420px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7a6f5e; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-field:focus-within .ds-field-label { color: #d0281c; } .ds-field-line { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-field-input { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #1a1612; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #e3d8bc; border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 2px; width: 100%; appearance: none; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #7a6f5e; opacity: 0.75; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: transparent; } .ds-field-rule { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: #d0281c; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1); pointer-events: none; } .ds-field:focus-within .ds-field-rule { transform: scaleX(1); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-field-rule { transition: none; } }

components.name: Tab Strip
components.description: Full-width equal tabs on Signal Red, with a yellow indicator that slides on an overshoot curve. State is carried twice: indicator position and label opacity.
components.html: MENULOCATIONSOUR STORY
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; position: relative; background: #d0281c; border-bottom: 3px solid #1a1612; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; font-family: 'Bowlby One', Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.11em; padding: 10px 4px; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; color: #fff2c9; display: block; line-height: normal; transition: opacity 0.25s, color 0.25s; } .ds-tab[aria-current='page'] { color: #fffdf6; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f5b82e; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-tabind { position: absolute; bottom: 0; height: 4px; background: #f5b82e; width: calc(100% / 3 * 0.66); left: calc(100% / 3 * (1 - 0.66) / 2); transition: transform 0.34s cubic-bezier(0.35, 1.3, 0.4, 1); }

components.name: Halftone Panel
components.description: The signature surface. Flat spot red under a tiled dot field at 0.16 opacity, which is what makes the color read as printed rather than as a CSS background.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #e63027; color: #fff2c9; padding: 34px 22px; } .ds-panel-dots { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: radial-gradient(#1a1612 1.15px, transparent 1.25px); background-size: 9px 9px; opacity: 0.16; pointer-events: none; } .ds-panel-h { position: relative; font-family: 'Bowlby One', Impact, sans-serif; font-size: 56px; line-height: 0.86; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin: 0; text-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #1a1612; } .ds-panel-h span { color: #ffd633; }

narrative.overview:
This is roadside signage you can order from. Warm paper, two spot colors laid down flat, everything outlined in near-black ink like a sign someone painted by hand and a printer reproduced badly on purpose. There is one palette and one light: daylight on Sunset Blvd. Nothing here dims, glows, or switches with the clock.

The register is brand: design is the product here. The site exists to send a hungry person to the order button, and it earns that by being unmistakably a specific place rather than a generic food page. Density is high and deliberately unrefined. Type is oversized past the point of comfort, borders are thick enough to read as physical edges, and nothing is soft.

What this system explicitly rejects: the delivery-app aesthetic it links out to, corporate chain polish, upscale-restaurant minimalism, and the hipster craft-burger kit of kraft paper and distressed textures.
keyCharacteristics: One palette, one light. No theme switch, no dark variant, no time-of-day behavior.
Zero rounding by default. Sharp corners everywhere except pills.
Shadows with no blur: solid ink offsets that read as printed registration, not lighting.
Three typefaces with three non-overlapping jobs: Bowlby One shouts, Inter explains, JetBrains Mono annotates.
Flat spot color. No gradients, no tints, no glass. A surface is one color.
Every interactive element travels physically on press.

rules.name: The Fill-Is-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: Counter Red and Marquee Yellow are fill colors. When either must carry text, it is swapped for its contrast-corrected cut: Signal Red for red surfaces under text, Marquee Yellow Ink for yellow text on red. Using the display cut for a text surface is prohibited. The hero learned this the hard way: cream on Counter Red tops out at 4.35:1, so nothing set on it at body size can pass.

rules.name: The Reserved Meaning Rule
rules.body: Yellow means price and primary action. Green means free or open. Red means the brand. A color used decoratively outside its meaning weakens every other use of it.

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Bowlby One shouts, Inter explains, JetBrains Mono annotates. A typeface used outside its job is a bug. Never set a sentence in Bowlby One. Never set a price in Inter.

rules.name: The 16px Floor Rule
rules.body: Any input a user types into is 16px minimum, because iOS Safari zooms the viewport below that and never zooms back. Everything else on the page may be smaller.

rules.name: The One Shout Rule
rules.body: One Display-scale element per page. A second one is not emphasis, it is noise, and it makes the first one meaningless.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: box-shadow blur is zero and the color is the ink. A blurred grey drop shadow on a card is the single fastest way to make this site look like every other food site. If it looks soft, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Falling Rule
rules.body: Pressable elements sit above their shadow and fall into it. :active translates the element by the shadow's offset and shrinks the shadow to match, so the element ends flush with the page. This is why offsets and translate distances are always the same number.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: This system has a single palette. There is no dark mode, no theme attribute, no time-of-day switch. A component that introduces a second set of colors is not a variant, it is a second design system.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Nothing on this site emits light. No neon, no bloom, no colored box-shadow with a blur radius. Depth is ink on paper.

dos: Do use zero-blur ink shadows at the documented offsets (2 / 3 / 4 / 6 / 7 / 10 / 14px). Size means importance.
Do make the travel distance on :active equal the shadow offset, so the element lands flat.
Do swap Counter Red for Signal Red (#d0281c) the moment text sits on it, and Marquee Yellow for #ffd633 the moment yellow becomes text on red.
Do set every input at 16px minimum.
Do keep Bowlby One for shouting, Inter for explaining, JetBrains Mono for annotating.
Do use tabular-nums on any figure that changes: prices, counts, hours, distances.
Do give every motion a prefers-reduced-motion exit.
Do carry state on two cues, not one.
Do keep prose to 65ch to 75ch, and the hero lede to 32ch.
Do lift a figure inside a mono row with weight, not with a second color.
donts: Don't add a dark mode, a theme toggle, or any time-of-day color behavior. This was removed deliberately.
Don't use a blurred or grey drop shadow. If it looks soft, it is wrong. Blur is reserved for the header, drawer and dock.
Don't emit light. No glow, no neon, no colored shadow with a blur radius.
Don't round corners. Square by default, 999px for pills, 50% for the status dot, and nothing else. There is no 20px left in the system.
Don't introduce a gradient, a tint, a glass surface or a backdrop-filter as decoration. Surfaces are one flat color.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient. The display face is already the emphasis.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on a card, row or callout.
Don't ship an identical card grid of icon plus heading plus paragraph.
Don't nest a card inside a card.
Don't reach for a modal. The site uses an item sheet, a bag drawer and inline expansion, in that order.
Don't look like the delivery app the order button links to: rounded stock-photo cards, sterile grids, neutral grey chrome.
Don't look like a corporate chain: regionless, committee-approved, safe.
Don't look like an upscale minimalist restaurant: thin serifs, stone neutrals, acres of whitespace, reservation-first.
Don't look like a hipster craft-burger shop: kraft paper textures, chalkboards, letterpress cliches, distressed overlays, the word artisan.
Don't use #000 or #fff. Every neutral in this system is warmed toward the brand.
Don't put a second Display-scale headline on a page.
Don't use em dashes in interface copy.
